question: In December 2020, ______ became the first country in the world to approve sale of lab grown chicken products.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Singapore.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Singapore has given U.S. start-up Eat Just the green light to sell its lab-grown chicken meat.
 
• It is the world's first regulatory approval for clean meat that does not come from slaughtered animals.
 
• Demand for alternatives to regular meat is surging due to consumer concerns about health, animal welfare and the environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Singapore: 

 
 
• Capital - Singapore City.

• President - Halimah Yacob.
